bio.text: Jake Ellzey represents Texas's 6th Congressional District and is serving his third term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He served 20 years in the U.S. Navy as a helicopter pilot and later a fighter pilot, and later worked as a commercial airline pilot and small business owner.
He served as Texas State Representative for House District 10 before Congress. He was born in Perryton, Texas, and lives in Ellis County.
